transform_embedding_request: transform OpenAI embedding input into Triton inference request format
transform_embedding_response: transform a Triton embedding HTTP response into a LiteLLM EmbeddingResponse object
build_embedding_usage: build a Usage object with prompt token counts from Triton embedding request data
